events.name: Florida State Seminoles Mens Basketball vs. Miami Hurricanes Mens Basketball
Club Seats - FSU MBB vs Miami
events.info: Enjoy FSU Men's Basketball from the best seats in the house! The Tucker Center offers premium seating for all men's basketball games so you can watch the action in style. Our Club Level seating includes luxury seats, a cash bar, dedicated club entrance, and premium club-level restrooms. Interested in Club Seat Season Tickets or ACC Pack Club Seats? Contact Shannon O'Hara, Group & Premium Sales Manager, at (850) 645-0746 or Shannon.Ohara@OakViewGroup.com

accessibility.info: Wheelchair accessible + companion seats can be purchased in groups of up to 4 seats.

generalInfo.generalRule: Prohibited items include but are not limited to: outside food or drink, carry bags or backpacks, bottles or cans, containers, illegal substances, incendiary devices, weapons of any type, strollers, banner sticks or flag poles, artificial noise making devices, laser pointers, helium balloons, audio or video recorders, pets other than service animals, professional cameras, or items the contents of which cannot be inspected or displayed. generalInfo.childRule: For most events, children 0-23 months are free unless otherwise noted. If a child has celebrated their 2nd birthday, they must have a ticket to enter. Children’s ticket policy may vary on some events.

events.name: Psychedelic Furs - All Ages (under 16 with adult)
Third Day with very special guest Zach Williams & Scout and the Saints
events.info: Experience THIRD DAY, the iconic band that shaped Christian music, for the final leg of their 30th Anniversary Tour. Original members Mac Powell, Mark Lee, David Carr, and Tai Anderson reunite for a limited run of U.S. shows celebrating three decades of hits from their legendary catalog. Very Special Guest Zach Williams joins each night and Scout and the Saints open, making these newly announced dates the final chapter of THIRD DAYs 30th Anniversary tour. Lineup subject to change. Discounts cannot be combined. Awakening Events / Awakening Foundation shows are required to follow local health and venue requirements. Changes in local health guidelines or venue policies are not grounds for a refund. By attending this event, you agree to all uses of photo/video content collected.
events.pleaseNote: To purchase 10 or more tickets contact Group & Premium Sales Manager, Shannon O'Hara, at (850) 645-0746 or Shannon.Ohara@OakViewGroup.com.
